verses.text: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
The LORD Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
God has put every nation under our power,
and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
Sing praises to God our King,
the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
